newsitem.title: INDIA: Crisil gives A+ rating for Indian GIIC bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Crisil gives A+ rating for Indian GIIC bond issue.

text.p: An 'A+' rating has been assigned to the proposed non-convertible debenture programme of Gujarat Industrial Investment Corporation Ltd (GIIC) indicating adequate safety of timely payment of interest and principal.

GIIC has traditionally been engaged in two main business activities, financial assistance through term lending to medium scale units in Gujarat and in promotion of joint and associate sector companies by participating in their equity capital.

In addition to term lending and equity participation, GIIC has over the last two years, diversified into fund based operations of leasing, corporate loans and bills discounting business, Crisil said in a statement.
